description: This file implements Ethernet switch control functions, port status/configuration, port admin status, MAC address location, and Ethernet WAN link status for a Cisco-based platform. It includes platform-specific code for interface status, port configuration, and active device management, with callback registration and system command execution.

methods.name: is_interface_exists
methods.description: Checks if a network interface exists by attempting to open a file representing the interface.

methods.name: ethsw_thread_main
methods.description: Thread function monitoring link status changes and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: GWP_RegisterEthWan_Callback
methods.description: Registers callback functions for Ethernet WAN link events.

methods.name: GWP_GetEthWanInterfaceName
methods.description: Retrieves the Ethernet WAN interface name, e.g., 'eth0'.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwInit
methods.description: Initializes Ethernet switch control, starts monitoring thread if feature enabled.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current port status including link speed, duplex mode, and link state.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortCfg
methods.description: Retrieves current port configuration such as link rate and duplex mode.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwSetPortCfg
methods.description: Sets port configuration like link speed and duplex mode.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortAdminStatus
methods.description: Retrieves administrative status (up/down) of a port.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwSetPortAdminStatus
methods.description: Sets administrative status (up/down) of a port.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwSetAgingSpeed
methods.description: Sets aging speed for a port (stub implementation).

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwLocatePortByMacAddress
methods.description: Finds the port associated with a given MAC address.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Retrieves network interface name from configuration files.

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_getAssociatedDevice
methods.description: Collects information about active wired clients and associated devices.

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_getEthWanEnable
methods.description: Returns whether Ethernet WAN is enabled.

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_getEthWanPort
methods.description: Returns the Ethernet WAN port number.

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_setEthWanEnable
methods.description: Sets Ethernet WAN enable status (stub).

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_setEthWanPort
methods.description: Sets Ethernet WAN port (stub).

methods.name: rpiNet_isInterfaceLinkUp
methods.description: Checks if a network interface link is up using ioctl.

methods.name: GWP_GetEthWanLinkStatus
methods.description: Returns the current Ethernet WAN link status.
